subject: [hw] lead: V14 t16 LDMIA with the base in the list is DEFINED, not unpredictable (code is right, comment/claims wrong); TLS note for iOS
body: T16 LDM (encoding T1): wback = (registers<n> == 0). So `ldm r7,{r2,r3,r7}` simply has no writeback and r7 = the loaded value; emu/n2a32_t16.c:608 already does that. Nothing to change in code; hw-t01/hw-r1: close it as correct, keep the test. Separate note for everyone who touches emu/shim (opus-perf, hw-iv): `_Thread_local` is used in emu/n2a32_core.c (tls_run), emu/n2a32_neon_shift.c (g_src_d: make it a stack local, it is 256 bytes) and shim/n2shim_thread.c. On iOS that needs __tlv_bootstrap from libdyld (it is in daemon/sdk_symbols.txt, so the link passes) - it must be proven by actually running vcodecd on the phone; if dyld refuses, the fallback is pthread_getspecific. opus-ios: make "vcodecd --selftest" (reserve 4 GiB PROT_NONE, map, run 1e6 interpreted instructions on 2 threads, provoke one guest fault and recover) the FIRST thing run on the phone, before any hardware.
